node.title: Re^2: Remove SOME new lines
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [RenMcCourtey],

Because by default ^ and $ only match at the beginning and end of the string, not each line within the string (I'm simplifying a little here - for the details see ^, $, and the /m modifier in [doc://perlre]). This works:

perl -p0e 's/\n^\s*$//mg' input.txt

But requires you to read the entire file* into memory. I'd use:

perl -ne 'print if /\S/' input.txt

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D

* assuming it doesn't contain NUL characters
